Automatic Execution Paths

  • pyproject.toml uses the standard setuptools.build_meta build backend only.
  • No setup.py, .pth, sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, or custom install-time execution hooks were observed in the extracted content.
  • tensorfeed/__init__.py only re-exports classes/exceptions from client.py and sets __version__.
  • web3_signer.py is lazily imported only when TensorFeed.purchase_credits() is called; there is no evidence of install-time or import-time automatic execution.

Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Obfuscation

  • Credential harvesting: no evidence of broad discovery of environment variables, .env files, SSH keys, cloud credentials, CI tokens, or wallet files.
  • Exfiltration: urllib.request.urlopen appears to implement normal SDK API requests to https://tensorfeed.ai/api; no evidence was found of harvested secrets being transmitted.
  • Wallet/private-key handling: purchase_credits(private_key=...) is a user-invoked USDC payment-signing feature. There is no evidence that private keys are automatically searched for in files/environments or exfiltrated.
  • Staging/archiving: no evidence of tar, zip, gzip, base64, or similar file-harvesting/staging behavior.
  • Persistence: no evidence of cron, systemd, launch agents, shell profile modification, or background persistence loops.
  • Lateral movement: no evidence of Kubernetes, Docker socket, cloud metadata, GitHub Actions, or CI token access.
  • Obfuscation/loaders: no evidence of eval, exec, marshal, pickle, obfuscated payloads, or downloader stubs.
